verdict.rationale: Thoropass publishes an official MCP server with a dedicated help article, and a probe confirmed that article exists. The article says an AI assistant can work directly inside the workspace within limits the user sets, with configurable scopes. Documented tools include listing audits and evidence requests, and adding comments, attachments and status updates. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working, and explicit detail on authentication and client setup in the evidence.
